prompts.locationScope: Pearl Creek, Brite Street at Lansdale Avenue, sidewalk and bank-facing street immediately south of the Bank; normal world
prompts.prompt:
Create ONE wide landscape 16:9 raster background plate for a 2D side-view fighting game, using the attached native gameplay storyboard references of Silent Hill: Downpour (2012). Output a single uninterrupted empty environment, NOT a montage/contact sheet; all pixels opaque. Remove all characters, monsters, UI, subtitles, watermarks and grid boundaries. This stage is specifically Pearl Creek, the Brite Street / Lansdale Avenue corner immediately south of the Bank, NORMAL WORLD. Do not substitute Overlook, Hillside, the radio tower, another Silent Hill game or a generic horror town.

Reference 1 is a 3 by 3 video storyboard: use its middle-center and middle-right panels (02:45:40 and 02:45:50) as PRIMARY visual evidence. They show the broad road, worn pale raised sidewalk, thin dark street poles, barren branches, and the pale stone Bank facade with tall recessed windows and an arched central entry in the background. The middle-left and top-left panels additionally show the nearby patched dark brick building, shuttered frontage and simple scaffold at the near corner. Reference 2 is secondary MATERIAL guidance only: its bottom row and middle-center show that corner's dark brickwork, corrugated shutter, simple cross-braced scaffold, and modest loose litter. Ignore interior and menu panels. Preserve the identifiable source materials and modest urban scale; do not redesign the facade into a cathedral or a grand new city.

Compose a calm side-on, eye-height arena with only shallow perspective: the Bank-facing road runs horizontally across the scene; the pale masonry facade sits across the street behind it, and a limited slice of the darker shuttered/scaffold corner can frame the far left background. Broad empty wet gray asphalt fills the bottom 28% and gives a straight horizontal fighter footing at normalized y=0.87. The entire central 86% must remain unobstructed at combat scale; no fence, car, bench, huge rubble pile, signboard or foreground prop across the lower middle. Keep any bollard/scaffold/pole and small debris mostly toward the outer edges or clearly behind the fighting plane. The two sides should feel part of the same actual streetscape, not a perfectly symmetrical invented arena. Thick gray-blue natural fog softens unseen distance. Desaturated cool concrete, dingy cream stone, charcoal brick, damp asphalt. Restrained realistic texture detail matching the supplied game environment, atmospheric low-contrast depth with readable silhouettes, no stylized line art, no poster typography.

The subtly damp road is the project's authored rainy-versus condition; do not paint dramatic rain streaks, lightning, floodwater, supernatural effects or falling hazards. No invented shop names, readable lettering or new story props. Show only architecture supported in the selected references; obscure unknown remote geometry with the source-like fog. Native detailed bitmap output, clean edges, full canvas. This is a source-guided scene adaptation with a new side-on camera, not a claim of exact 1:1 reproduction.

prompts.locationScope: Central Square Shopping Center, underground Split Worm arena, fixed altered world, three tunnel mouths on the far wall; three opposing mouths outside this camera
prompts.prompt:
Create ONE uninterrupted wide landscape 16:9 raster background plate for a 2D side-view fighting game, guided by the supplied native Silent Hill 3 (2003 PC) gameplay images. Single empty location, opaque background, NOT a grid, contact sheet or collage. The EXACT location is the underground Split Worm arena beneath the Central Square Shopping Center in the altered Nightmare Mall. This is NOT a shopping concourse or another game's dungeon.

The first two references are 5-by-5 storyboard grids from the actual Split Worm fight. Use reference 1 row 3 columns 2–4 and row 4 columns 2–4, and reference 2 row 3 columns 2–5 for the architecture. The third reference is a 3-by-3 grid from the arena introduction: its middle and bottom rows corroborate the red-painted steel cross-braces, dirty pale panels, gallery and ladder. Ignore every person and creature, black padding and grid seams. Preserve the source design: a compact rectangular industrial pit, a low grimy gray-beige slab floor, dark squat rectangular tunnel mouths on opposed walls, narrow structural piers, a rusty dull-red steel horizontal gallery and diagonal braces above the mouths, stained concrete/infill panels and dim void above. The arena has SIX tunnels in total, arranged THREE ON EACH OPPOSING WALL. In this new side-on view show the three on the far wall; the three on the near wall lie outside the camera, do not place six side-by-side across one wall. Their dark mouths are low and broad rather than gigantic fantasy arches. No fancy sewer pipes or round tunnel rings.

Camera is near fighter eye height, level, facing the long far wall almost square on, with very shallow side-wall perspective. Form an empty horizontal combat lane at the bottom of the scene: worn square concrete/stone slabs in dirty ochre-gray, extending unbroken across the entire width, broad lower 30%, footing normalized y=0.87. Midground wall openings and structural piers remain behind the fighting lane. No pits, upright rubble, monster, ladder, pole or fence across the clear middle combat floor. The source's red steel beams and diagonal braces belong behind and above the action, no decorative beam across fighter silhouettes. Keep the space limited and industrial, not a vast temple. Restrained dirty cream-gray material, dark rust-red braces, deep brown-black tunnels, muted localized dim illumination sufficient to read the floor. Detailed realistic game-environment texture with uneven stains and plausible wear from the reference, no cartoony contours, no new symbols, signs, lettering or supernatural effects. Remove ALL monsters, people, blood spray, UI, subtitles and watermark. Do not introduce meat walls, body parts, ritual ornaments, hanging figures or new lore. Source-guided static environment candidate with a new versus camera; no pretense of reconstructing hidden exact geometry.

prompts.locationScope: Overlook Penitentiary, Cell Block B upper catwalk by the barred cells and lever, normal phase before the later cage sequence
prompts.prompt:
Create ONE uninterrupted wide landscape 16:9 raster background plate for a 2D side-view fighting game based on the attached native Silent Hill: Homecoming gameplay storyboard images. Single empty environment, opaque canvas. Never reproduce their grid/contact-sheet layout. Exact location: Overlook Penitentiary, NORMAL Cell Block B, the upper cell-side coursive/catwalk before the later Otherworld cage sequence. The maps visible in reference 2 identify Cell Wing B; use only for locality, not as artwork. No Downpour prison, panopticon, cell block A, underground water prison or invented punishment room.

The references are 3-by-3 native video storyboard grids. Primary architecture: reference 1 top-left and bottom row; reference 2 middle row; reference 3 middle-left and middle-center. Observe heavy oxidized rectangular steel square-grid cell gates, thick concrete/masonry piers, rough pale dirty gray-green walls with cracks and flaked surfaces, simple wall lever boxes, and worn rectangular metal-grating walkway panels with dull rails at the side of a dark central void. Preserve those materials and scale. Remove people, streamer face overlays, maps, inventory, text captions and every interface element. Do not copy character faces or silhouettes into stains.

Compose a nearly straight side-on view along a SHORT section of Cell Block B, with the observed cell gates forming the rear wall, and the catwalk rendered as a broad level continuous empty floor across the lower 28% of the image. This width is the versus adaptation: enough empty room for fighters, feet at normalized y=0.87, no hole or sudden drop through the playing area. Keep the distant rail/drop suggestion only at outer corners, and no railing, bars, doorway jamb or object covering the central 86% in the foreground. Use a few source-like heavy grid gates separated by stout masonry bays; preserve the modest grim scale, do not build a new multi-storey grand prison hall. Cracked concrete and metal grating have physical believable worn texture, cool gray-blue ambient darkness, faint dusty illumination along the floor and walls, calm readable medium contrast. Source game environment style with detailed raster materials, not painterly concept art.

No people, prisoners, bodies, monsters, weapons, gore, hanging cages, glowing occult symbols, flesh growth, flames, pools, snow, fake warning text, signage or readable cell numbers. No overt theatrical spotlight. Light enough to distinguish fighter silhouettes against the cell bars. Full canvas with opaque background. This is a documented side-on adaptation of the normal B-cell coursive using observed materials, not a certified 1:1 reconstruction.

prompts.locationScope: Daisy Villa Apartments rooftop, Missionary encounter at night, normal-world architecture
prompts.prompt:
Create ONE wide landscape 16:9 opaque raster environment plate for a 2D side-view fighting game. The attached native Silent Hill 3 gameplay storyboard images show the EXACT scene: Daisy Villa Apartments ROOFTOP during the Missionary encounter at night. A single empty uninterrupted roof environment, not a contact sheet and not an interior corridor. Remove characters, creature, interface, captions and grid seams. Original game's architecture and material character are the guide.

References 1 and 2 each contain 3-by-3 gameplay panels, the first at 01:30–02:10 and the second at 02:15–02:55 of the Missionary video. Use all unobscured roof surfaces across these views. They establish large dirty pale gray SQUARE rooftop paving slabs, thin low metal guardrails with horizontal rails at the perimeter, dark masonry/concrete rooftop utility walls, small dark rectangular service openings or vent panels, modest service-door architecture, and very dark empty night above. Reference 3's middle-right and lower panels are cutscene evidence for the same rooftop's rough dark masonry wall and blue-black rectangular service-door frame behind Claudia. Ignore indoor apartment panels and every figure. Keep the original low utilitarian residential roof scale, NOT an industrial megastructure. Only add forms visible in these views; unknown distance remains obscured by darkness and faint gray fog.

Compose a level side-on horizontal fighting area with shallow perspective and a long row of source-like gray square roof slabs extending across the lower 30% of the image, fighter footing at normalized y=0.87. Broad unbroken floor, no hole or curb in the active combat lane, no railing or foreground vertical post through the central 86% of the image. The low perimeter railing belongs BEHIND the lane, with a portion of the dark low masonry roof access/utility wall and its simple service doorway offset toward the right background. Retain an open exterior sense and black muted gray night above; this is a roof, not a fully enclosed room. Let the left background dissolve into dark fog beyond the rail instead of inventing detailed skyline geography. Floor is matte worn concrete-gray pavers with restrained subtle dampness, not flooded or mirror-glossy. No visible rain streaks, storm lightning, snow, falling debris or supernatural effects. Dim cool diffuse illumination can be slightly raised for fighter readability but keep the subdued original nighttime palette, not sunny daytime or neon.

Detailed realistic raster material with chipped grout, worn dark metal and dirty masonry, restrained desaturated tones; no cartoon outlines, painterly sketch or typography. No characters, faces in shadows, bodies, monsters, weapons, blood, occult symbols, water towers, giant turbines, invented antennas or narrative props. Preserve recognizable observed architecture while acknowledging the new horizontal versus camera as an adaptation, not certified 1:1 reconstruction.

prompts.locationScope: Pearl Creek, Brite Street at Lansdale Avenue, sidewalk and bank-facing street immediately south of the Bank; normal world
prompts.prompt:
Generate ONE wide landscape 16:9 transparent RGBA PNG stage foreground overlay. The attached image is the already selected background and is provided ONLY to match materials, lighting and the camera. Do NOT reproduce that background. Do NOT include ground, sky, scene, wall across the canvas, gradients, white fill, black fill, checkerboard texture, fog, shadows floating in empty space, labels, borders, text, UI, people or monsters. The output consists only of TWO disconnected very narrow pieces of source-like near-edge architecture at the far left and far right image boundary. This is a sparse foreground overlay for a fighting game, not a complete picture of the background.

CRITICAL ALPHA AND COMPOSITION CONTRACT: every pixel across the central 88% of canvas, from x=0.06 to x=0.94 for the ENTIRE height y=0.0–1.0, must be fully transparent alpha zero. Keep all nontransparent architecture strictly inside x=0.00–0.045 and x=0.955–1.00. The center and the combat feet band must remain genuinely empty transparency, with no bridge, cable, branch, rail, floor strip, glow, dust or grain crossing through it. Both outer edge pieces must reach the canvas boundary so they read as cropped nearby environment, not isolated props in the middle. Keep the same wide canvas as the reference background. Actual transparent alpha, never a painted checkerboard. Sharp natural antialiased object edges; source-like high quality raster texture without outlines.

For this Pearl Creek street overlay: at the extreme LEFT show only a slim slice of weathered dark brick corner and one dull scaffold tube, cropped by the left image boundary. At the extreme RIGHT show only a slim partial weathered street-pole shaft, cropped by the right image boundary. The width of each visible fragment is at most 4% of the whole image. Match the supplied cool fog-muted brick, gray mortar and dark metal. No base spreading toward center. The poles and brick have ordinary static urban form, no invented objects or decorations. Do not add the Bank, road, tree, wet ground or fog from the reference.
